_comment: Client-provided Portfolio Name-to-Portfolio Code mapping ('Utilize the client-provided Portfolio Name-to-Portfolio Code mapping to identify and correlate documents where standardized portfolio codes are not available in incoming instructions'). The requirements-clarification call flagged this mapping as a hard prerequisite BIFM still owes as an Excel sheet ('you have to give us the mapping then... otherwise AI will never know what it is'); the first entries below are BIFM's own real codes+names, confirmed directly from their real sample documents (Ops Samples.zip, 2026-07-22, plus the daily Cash ledgers and BULMMF_8A schedule) - extend with BIFM's full mapping once delivered, or point OPS_PORTFOLIO_MAPPING at that client-supplied CSV (name,code[,aliases]) without touching this file. The remaining entries are synthetic demo/test data (also exercised by tests/test_ops_uc2.py) kept so the existing test suite and salesperson-roster demo still work; safe to remove once real data fully replaces the demo. aliases: alternative spellings/short names clients actually write in emails/letters. _note (optional, ignored by the app): provenance for entries added from live testing - what document confirmed the code/name, or, for code-only entries, that no real name was ever stated in the sample set and 'name' is only a placeholder equal to 'code' until BIFM's real mapping supplies one - never fabricate a plausible-sounding fund name.
